title: Consume Wispr credentials at request time
description: Listener must read the established wispr-flow/credentials GoPass entry through a child-process descriptor, parse supported desktop session variants in process, derive provider identities there, and keep session bytes outside observable and durable state.
design: Replace separate secret lookups with one request-time GoPass document consumer whose child stdout is piped directly into bounded in-process parsing. Reuse the supported desktop session parser for Supabase and WorkOS variants.
acceptance_criteria: Offline behavioral tests prove the supported session variants derive the provider token and identity from one document, missing/malformed documents are unavailable, and production construction uses no legacy per-field credential source.
close_reason: The focused Rust test was red before session-id derivation and green afterward; the Nix test check passed with one GoPass document shared by bearer and identity parsing.
